Keeping Tabs

Wed Jun 04 2025 20:00:00 GMT-0400 (Eastern Daylight Time)

I've been meaning to start blogging for a while now ... and here we are! My appreciation for these corners of the internet started in high school when I discovered Wait but Why. Then when I began applying to college, I got in the habit of religiously checking the MIT Admissions Blogs. As I finish up my M.Eng degree (7 years later 🤯) and prepare to enter a Ph.D program, I'm reading lots from academics at all stages of their career (Sandra Bae, Matt Might).

In particular, Matt's advice convinced me to finally try my hand at keeping a blog, and I'm going to give it a shot over the next few months. ChatGPT recommended the 11ty framework which has made it super easy, and now I have no excuse.

I have lots of ideas for future posts, but for this one I'd like to set some intentions.

  • I want to practice writing, so rest-assured dear reader all words written here are mine.

  • I want to document new things I've learned, even (especially?) if nothing remarkable came of it.

  • I want to reflect on career, but also

  • I want to share what I'm up to outside of work.

As this new corner of the internet is birthed, I'll leave you with some others I revisit from time to time

  • Picking a career
  • Finding meaning in science
  • Productivity Tips
  • Systems Research Thinking
